name: The Wheel

gist.Serpentous Demon: When it dies a Hydrogen Demon takes its place from the deck. Arriving through the cycle it draws two.
gist.Hydrogen Demon: When it dies a Herbithorn Demon replaces it. Arriving through the cycle it freezes one of your heroes.
gist.Herbithorn Demon: When it dies a Bouldor Demon replaces it. Arriving through the cycle it takes a card from any discard pile.
gist.Bouldor Demon: When it dies an Infernous Demon replaces it. Arriving through the cycle it makes you discard two.
gist.Infernous Demon: When it dies a Serpentous Demon replaces it. Arriving through the cycle it hits three times.
gist.Asriel, the Sapling Sacrificer: May sacrifice creatures with Occultism the very turn they arrive.
gist.Calamitusk, the Chaorc War Chief: Sacrifices an older creature to summon a Chaorc from the deck.
gist.Elana, the Rocky Rebel: Reshuffles her hand for one more card.
gist.Occultism: Ability: sacrifice a creature to hit a target.
gist.Temple of Sacrifice: Her sacrifice outlet beyond the heroes.
gist.Chaorc Ruin Mourner: Hits a target on every sacrifice.
gist.Chaorc Friendly Fireballer: Fetches and casts Fireball on sacrifices.
gist.Chosen Sacrifice: Sacrificed from hand instead of a creature.
gist.The Cosmic Depths: Area: once per turn a player may shuffle a hand card away to search out and summon a creature of a level they do not yet control (its effect is off for that turn).
gist.Arrival from the Cosmic Depths: Places a Cosmic Depths creature from his deck on YOUR side, then summons a bigger one for himself, all as a free action.
gist.Gatherer from the Cosmic Depths: Collects a Change Counter whenever its controller's opponent draws or searches by an effect; counters can be cashed in for cards.
gist.Life-Searcher from the Cosmic Depths: Arrives through Cosmic effects, searches another Cosmic card and can later swap itself for something from the deck.
gist.Analyzer from the Cosmic Depths: Collects a Change Counter whenever its controller's opponent draws or searches by an effect and spends them to drop Invader Tokens. While a token is out, a player who controls no card with Change Counters must discard a card or take a small hit at the end of each of their turns.
gist.Invader from the Cosmic Depths: A large creature that only Cosmic cards can summon; arrives with two Invader Tokens and discards spells for heavy hits.

plan: Five Demons, each replaced from the deck by the next when it dies, each arriving with a gift: two cards, a frozen hero, a card from a discard pile, two discards from you, three hits. Fiona kills her own Demons with Occultism and the Chaorc sacrifice engine, so one creature slot turns the whole wheel in a turn, and the Ruin Mourner and Fireballer pay again for every sacrifice. It does not matter who kills a Demon: your sweepers, your Storm and The Yeeting turn the wheel for her. It is one of the strongest decks in the year. The way in is through the heroes who do the sacrificing, and through taking a Demon without killing it. AS THE GUEST PLAYS IT: it is still this deck, and it is no longer played the way its owner played it. A handful of cards that were never in the list (The Cosmic Depths, Arrival, Analyzer, Gatherer, Life-Searcher) let it fetch the exact piece it is missing every turn, and the pilot holds resources back and keeps its answers for the right moment. The deck's strengths and weaknesses are unchanged; what has changed is that the mistakes are gone.

looks.early: One Demon and a quiet girl. And an unfamiliar Area with a starfield on it.
looks.mid: The same support zone holding a different Demon five times in one turn; your caster frozen, your hand two cards shorter.
looks.late: A Ruin Mourner hitting on every turn of the wheel.

opening.tell: A single Demon sits on her side; killing it would only bring the next one, with its gift.
opening.why: Every Demon that dies is replaced and pays her, so the board must be left alone: her heroes are ordinary and the sacrificing runs through them.

midgame.tell: Asriel sacrifices a Demon the turn it lands and the wheel turns three times.
midgame.why: Freeze Asriel and the wheel needs a full turn per step; Dark Gear takes a Demon without killing it. Sweeping, the Storm's ticks on creatures and The Yeeting all count as kills and turn it for her.

crisis.tell: A Ruin Mourner is out and every sacrifice hits you; your caster is frozen by a Hydrogen Demon.
crisis.why: Tea the freeze back, shield the hero the Mourner is working on, and keep hero damage going; clearing Demons feeds the Mourner.

endgame.tell: Her deck is running out of Demons to fetch and Asriel is low.
endgame.why: The wheel stops when a Demon has no successor left in the deck.

opening.board: Fiona summons a Serpentous Demon and waits for you to kill it.

options.text: Kill it and meet the next

opening.board: She sacrifices it herself: a Hydrogen Demon arrives and freezes your caster.
A Chosen Sacrifice from hand feeds Occultism.

midgame.board: Three sacrifices in one turn: you discard two, take three hits, she draws two.
Your Storm tick kills a Demon she offered up; the next arrives with its gift.
Herbithorn takes your Flame Avalanche out of your discard pile.

options.text: White Eye it back out of her hand

crisis.board: The Ruin Mourner hits on every step of the wheel.

options.text: Shield the target, Tea the freeze, burn Asriel

crisis.board: The Fireballer casts a Fireball it fetched from a sacrifice.
Deepsea Idol protects her board anyway.

endgame.board: No Serpentous left in her deck: the wheel has a gap.
